# DevCenterPoint

> DevCenterPoint is a custom software development studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, building full-stack SaaS platforms, AI-powered systems, cloud infrastructure, and high-performance business applications.

## Core Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://devcenterpoint.com/services): Full-stack SaaS, modern web applications, high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and legacy modernization.
- [AI & Intelligent Systems](https://devcenterpoint.com/services): Practical machine learning, SHAP/LIME explainability, LLM API integration, RAG workflows, predictive data ingestion.
- [Experience Design](https://devcenterpoint.com/services): Token-driven design systems, high-density interfaces, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, zero layout shift (CLS < 0.05).
- [Enterprise ERP & Business Systems](https://devcenterpoint.com/services): Custom ERP, POS, B2B CRM, inventory/WMS, immutable audit logs, offline-first sync.
- [Commerce Infrastructure](https://devcenterpoint.com/services): Headless e-commerce, multi-vendor marketplaces, Stripe payment gateway switches, sub-second checkout speeds.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://devcenterpoint.com/services): Kubernetes, Docker, automated CI/CD pipelines, zero-downtime blue/green and canary deployments.

## Verified Production Metrics
- Uptime SLA: 99.98% production availability
- API Latency Target: <50ms server response
- Code Quality Gates: 100% strict TypeScript compilation with zero `any` exemptions
- Feature Velocity: 65% faster time-to-market via modular architecture

- Fixed-Scope Milestone Tranches: Guaranteed-budget execution with deterministic phase sign-offs.
- Fractional CTO & Systems Advisory: High-leverage architecture audits, technology selection, and technical leadership.
